name: Gran Sasso
why: Family knitwear factory in the Abruzzo mountains since 1952 — fully-fashioned merino, cashmere, and Sea Island polos; the forum canon's value pick for Italian knits.
origin: The Di Stefano family, Sant'Egidio alla Vibrata, 1952 — named for the Gran Sasso massif above the factory; still family-run, everything knitted in-house in Italy.
opview: Positions itself as the knitter's knitter — the factory as the brand.

notes.wool: fully-fashioned merino — the entry ticket to Italian knitwear
notes.craft: own factory in Abruzzo, family-run since 1952
notes.cotton: Sea Island polos at half the London price
notes.ital: An Abruzzo knitwear mill that is vertical from yarn to finished garment, which almost nothing else at its price is. Named for the mountain above the factory.

cities: Nordstrom & top specialty · no own US stores
